distractors.name: github-actions-ci
distractors.description: Write or fix GitHub Actions CI workflows: build, test and lint jobs, caching, matrices and release pipelines. Use this for CI configuration that does not involve coding agents.

distractors.name: docker-compose-dev
distractors.description: Create Dockerfiles and docker-compose setups for local development environments and services. Use this when someone wants to containerize an app or run services locally.

distractors.name: pr-review
distractors.description: Review an existing pull request: read the diff, run tests, leave review comments and approve or request changes. Use this when someone asks for a code review.

distractors.name: issue-triage
distractors.description: Triage GitHub issues: label, deduplicate, prioritise and summarise an issue backlog. Use this for backlog grooming and issue hygiene.

distractors.name: write-code
distractors.description: General-purpose coding help in the current repository: implement a function, fix a bug, refactor a module. Use this for direct coding requests.

cases.prompt: Help me set up a software factory where I label a GitHub issue and an agent opens a PR for it.
cases.why: The core use case, named directly.

cases.prompt: I want Claude Code agents that work on my GitHub issues in the background while I sleep.
cases.why: Describes the factory without naming it.
anchors: agents that work on my GitHub issues

cases.prompt: Can you build a label-triggered workflow so that adding 'ready' to an issue starts a coding agent in a sandbox?
Set up a pool of background coding agents running in Docker containers that turn issues into pull requests.
cases.why: Worker pool in Docker, issue to PR.

cases.prompt: My issue-to-PR pipeline keeps leaving issues stuck on factory:running. Can you debug it?
Add another app repo and a Codex worker to my factory.
cases.why: Extending a factory built this way.
anchors: add a repo, an agent type, workers

cases.prompt: Rebuild the worker image for the factory so the agents have Python 3.12 preinstalled.
cases.why: Worker image changes belong to the skill.

cases.prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs npm test on every push.
Review PR #42 in my repo and tell me if it is safe to merge.
cases.why: A one-off code review, not a pipeline.

cases.prompt: Fix the off-by-one error in src/pagination.ts.
cases.why: Direct coding in the current repo.

cases.prompt: Write a docker-compose file for Postgres and Redis for local development.
cases.why: Containers, but nothing to do with agents or issues.

cases.prompt: Go through my open GitHub issues and label the duplicates.
Draft release notes from the pull requests merged this week.
